summary: Four-pose reference sheet for Door Bouncer, the Club DB security bouncer responsible for controlling access at the club door. Shows neutral standing, welcome/entry, check/verification, and stop/closed poses with signature door and entry props.

character: Bearded adult man with medium-brown skin
Wears a black baseball cap and black Club DB security polo
Friendly but authoritative facial expression and posture
costume: Black short-sleeve polo with Club DB patch on the chest
Black trousers with belt and black work shoes
Employee badge on a lanyard labeled DOOR BOUNCER
signature_props: Club DB door or entry barrier such as a rope, gate, or door prop
Guest list, entry log, or wristband for verification
Open/closed or welcome/stop sign for access control
poses: 1: Neutral standing at the door holding an entry prop
2: Welcome / open pose gesturing guests inside
3: Check / verification pose with guest list or wristband
4: Stop / closed pose blocking or holding the door
color_notes: Dominant black uniform with white badge text
Subtle green check marks or red X marks as status accents

Keep the black cap, black Club DB polo, black trousers, and black work shoes
Maintain friendly but authoritative body language and clear facial expression
Retain the lanyard badge labeled DOOR BOUNCER
negative_constraints: Do not omit the door/entry prop or access item from any pose
Do not change the door color or entry sign away from the reference
Do not add unrelated accessories, weapons, or alternate costumes
Do not alter the Club DB patch or badge text
